parsed.explanation: No visitor-facing universal-exposure measure is documented: same-sex conduct decriminalised 2021, orientation-based discrimination criminalised, no trans-specific border, facility, or documented birth-sex custody rule, and no organised targeting. But there is also no documented working remedy for trans people: constitutional grounds do not enumerate gender, no legal gender recognition route exists, and a 2024 shadow report records persistent discrimination plus a trans woman physically attacked, arbitrarily detained and degraded by police — a state-agent incident under internal military-police investigation. Violence and custody data are undocumented (thin-data state, so silence is not safety). Net: documented state-implicated harm with weak recourse, no universal exclusion — Elevated Risk, upper-middle.
